title: Encounter Difficulty Drift
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session encounter_difficulty=*
| stats avg(encounter_difficulty) as avg_difficulty, avg(party_level) as avg_party_level, count as encounters by campaign arc
| eval delta=round(avg_difficulty-avg_party_level,2)
| sort - delta
description: Tracks whether encounter difficulty is drifting too far above or below the party's average level across story arcs.
value: A campaign feels best when challenge scales with the table; this helps a GM spot over-tuned fights or boring steamrolls.
implementation: Ingest encounter summary fields into `index=personal`; compare average encounter difficulty with party level by arc.
visualization: Table of arcs with average difficulty delta.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how hard your encounters are compared with the party so the campaign stays tense without becoming a slog.
